data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 0c26228c77e3322b10a488eb32ef037ca16a127c

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Outbound bridge should not post the same comment (same origin-uuid marker) more than once to a Jira issue. The 2026-05-11 dedup fix was intended to prevent this.

#### Actual Behavior

DIG-1646 Jira comments 157953 and 158046 contain identical text and the same origin-uuid marker.

Same pattern repeats on the following comment pairs/triples in DIG-1646:
- 158376 / 158392 / 158407
- 158667 / 158690 / 158722

Pattern observed on 2026-05-08, 2026-05-11, and 2026-05-12 — persists after the 5/11 dedup fix.

### 3. Action History

Hypothesis: the dedup path checks the local DefenseStore/origin-uuid registry but does not query existing Jira comments before posting, so a local-state reset or missed write causes a re-post that the destination cannot defend against.

### 6. Logs

Reproduction: open DIG-1646 in Jira, search for repeated origin-uuid strings within comment bodies — multiple matches present.
data.title: [Outbound Bridge]: origin-uuid dedup ineffective against destination -> duplicate comments posted to Jira
